verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a public REST API for programmatically setting up and scaling pipelines and managing the account. It has a getting-started guide, lists API access on its pricing plans, and ships an official MCP server with read/write scopes for agent-driven operation. One community comment says the APIs are unreliable, but it does not contradict the documented capability, so it only lowers confidence. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), detailed endpoint coverage in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
